/.title: PadelKit Docs
/.description: Learn everything about the PadelKit library and integrate 3D court geometry, camera calibration, 9D physics, scoring, and visualization into your Python workflows.

/quickstart.title: Quickstart
/quickstart.description: Install PadelKit and run practical examples across court geometry, camera projection, 9D physics, scoring, and 3D visualization.

/court-geometry.title: Court Geometry
/court-geometry.description: Understand FIP court dimensions, CENTERED vs CORNER_BASED coordinate frames, enclosure variants, lateral doors, and Rule 16 safety clearances.

/camera-system.title: Camera System & 3D Projection
/camera-system.description: Understand World, OpenCV Camera, OpenGL, and Image Sensor coordinate frames, lens distortion, and landmark-based camera calibration.

/ball-physics.title: Ball Aerodynamics & Contact Physics
/ball-physics.description: Learn the 9D state model, quadratic felt drag, Spindt Magnus spin lift, and analytical Sliding vs Rolling rebound mechanics.

/visualization-3d.title: 3D Visualization & Replay Studio
/visualization-3d.description: Explore PadelVisualizer operating modes: Parquet/CSV replay, real-time SSE streaming, standalone offline HTML, and CV inspection passes.

/stroke-library.title: Stroke & Skeletal Animation Library
/stroke-library.description: Standardized padel stroke taxonomy, 9D launch spin profiles, MotionBERT skeletal normalization, and contact_swing_phase synchronization.

/scoring-system.title: Scoring System
/scoring-system.description: Learn event-sourced scoring, Advantage vs Punto de Oro, tiebreak server rotations, and automatic FIP Rule 5 court end changes.

/match-format.title: Universal Match Format (.parquet)
/match-format.description: Two-layer single-file Apache Parquet specification combining static venue/match JSON metadata with 51/255 columnar dynamic frame data.

/court.title: Court
/court.description: API reference for the Court dataclass, 2D/3D landmarks, panel decomposition, doorways, and FIP compliance validation.

/court-dimensions.title: CourtDimensions
/court-dimensions.description: API reference for all 11 official FIP court measurements, markings, net heights, and free clearance presets.

/court-location.title: CourtLocation
/court-location.description: API reference for optional venue club, city, country, and WGS84 GPS coordinate metadata.

/side-access.title: SideAccess
/side-access.description: API reference for lateral doorway count, clear opening dimensions, Y-intervals, and FIP single/dual access presets.

/safety-zone.title: SafetyZone
/safety-zone.description: API reference for Rule 16 exterior out-of-court obstacle-free clearance volume and frame padding.

/side-enclosure-panel.title: SideEnclosurePanel
/side-enclosure-panel.description: API reference for rectangular full-sideline wall, glass, wire mesh, lintel, and closed gate panels.

/side-enclosure-segment.title: SideEnclosureSegment
/side-enclosure-segment.description: API reference for longitudinal half-side wall/mesh segments measured inward from the back wall.

/court-landmark.title: CourtLandmark
/court-landmark.description: API reference for the 17 standardized court reference points (13 floor markings + 4 elevated wall corners).

/court-enums.title: Court Enums
/court-enums.description: Reference for CoordinateSystem, EnclosureType, EnclosureVariant, SideWallProfile, CourtSurfaceColor, CourtOrientation, DoorState, and CourtSetting.

/camera.title: Camera
/camera.description: API reference for the projective Camera class, venue presets, DLT/LM landmark calibration, and 3D-2D ray casting.

/camera-intrinsics.title: CameraIntrinsics
/camera-intrinsics.description: API reference for image sensor resolution, focal lengths, optical center, FOV properties, and calibration matrix K.

/camera-extrinsics.title: CameraExtrinsics
/camera-extrinsics.description: API reference for 6-DoF camera world pose, look-at/Euler/RT constructors, and OpenCV/OpenGL transform matrices.

/camera-distortion.title: CameraDistortion
/camera-distortion.description: API reference for Pinhole, Brown-Conrady, and Kannala-Brandt Fisheye forward distortion and iterative undistortion.

/camera-enums.title: Camera Enums
/camera-enums.description: Reference for CameraPreset venue viewpoints and DistortionModel optical formulations.

/ball-physics-engine.title: BallPhysicsEngine
/ball-physics-engine.description: API reference for the 9D RK4 aerodynamics integrator, analytical collision solver, single simulate(), and batch simulate_batch().

/ball-state.title: BallState
/ball-state.description: API reference for instantaneous 9D kinematic ball state, from_shot() spin decomposition, speed, and RPM helpers.

/ball-trajectory.title: BallTrajectory
/ball-trajectory.description: API reference for simulated 9D trajectory series, timestamp interpolation, analytics, CSV/DataFrame export, and to_timeline().

/bounce-event.title: BounceEvent
/bounce-event.description: API reference for pre/post-impact velocity, angular spin, surface, and contact regime bounce records.

/ball-properties.title: BallProperties
/ball-properties.description: API reference for regulation padel ball mass, radius, inertia, felt fuzz_factor, pressure, FIP colors, and presets.

/environment-conditions.title: EnvironmentConditions
/environment-conditions.description: API reference for gravity, ambient air density, wind vector, spin decay rate, and Tetens barometric atmosphere presets.

/surface-materials.title: SurfaceMaterials
/surface-materials.description: API reference for restitution (COR), friction, wire-fence randomness, and net damping across all court surfaces.

/physics-enums.title: Physics Enums
/physics-enums.description: Reference for BallColor, SurfaceType, and ContactRegime enumerations.

/match.title: Match
/match.description: API reference for the top-level Match aggregate wrapping teams, rules, score history, court, and winner completion status.

/match-configuration.title: MatchConfiguration
/match-configuration.description: API reference for validated match format rules: best_of_sets, advantage vs gold_point, set formats, and deciding sets.

/match-score.title: MatchScore
/match-score.description: API reference for immutable score snapshots including points, games, sets, active server, and FIP Rule 5 side changes.

/match-score-history.title: MatchScoreHistory
/match-score-history.description: API reference for the event-sourced point ledger supporting add_point(), modify_point(), and deterministic score replay.

/team.title: Team
/team.description: API reference for competing doubles pairs, serve formations, and display labels.

/player.title: Player
/player.description: API reference for individual padel players, receiving court side preferences, and nationality metadata.

/serving-state.title: ServingState
/serving-state.description: API reference for point-level active server, receiver, and diagonal service box state.

/serving-engine.title: ServingEngine
/serving-engine.description: API reference for the stateless doubles and tiebreak server/receiver rotation calculator.

/scoring-enums.title: Scoring Enums
/scoring-enums.description: Reference for TeamId pair identifiers (A and B).

/padel-visualizer.title: PadelVisualizer
/padel-visualizer.description: API reference for the interactive Three.js 3D court studio, Parquet/CSV replay, offline HTML export, and live SSE streaming.

/match-timeline.title: MatchTimeline
/match-timeline.description: API reference for temporal 60 FPS timelines, physics demo rallies, H36M skeletal baking, and Parquet/CSV/DataFrame I/O.

/frame-state.title: FrameState
/frame-state.description: API reference for single-timestamp ball kinematics, 4-player poses, event tags, and scoreboard state.

/player-pose.title: PlayerPose
/player-pose.description: API reference for player court root pose, yaw heading, stroke animation phase, and 17 H36M 3D skeletal keypoints.

/viz-constants.title: Visualization Constants
/viz-constants.description: Reference for the canonical 17-joint H36M_JOINT_NAMES skeletal landmark ordering.
